name: Summon Swords
rationale: Ender focus animates Iron-and-Flint blades; Emerald, Amethyst and a feather describe their directed flying bodies.

parts.rationale: Iron mana/regeneration/cast-time crafting family; native focusing role

clues: Outer Plinths hold passage focus, flint motif, resonant facet; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Passage focus follows blank inscription clockwise.
Bound metal follows passage focus clockwise.
Flint motif follows bound metal clockwise.
Evocation focus follows flint motif clockwise.
Resonant facet follows evocation focus clockwise.
Feather motif follows resonant facet clockwise.
Blank inscription follows feather motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
